text:
Ezra: heads-up -- I'm preparing a short deprecation plan for the old /optimize paths now that most optkit content is live under /optkit. want to align on timeline and safety nets.
Nia: good call. we had a few surprise 404s in staging yesterday. what's the proposed timeline?
Ezra: propose two-phase: (1) add data-driven redirects + snippet compatibility layer, keep old pages for 14 days; (2) run linkcheck and notify downstream owners, then schedule deletes in week 3.
Cal: sounds sensible. list of safety items?
Ezra: minimal checklist: mapping YAML in docs/_data/legacy_optimize_map.yml, Sphinx redirect generator that emits tiny HTML redirect pages, snippet preprocessor for import rewrites when building staging, anchors.json for fragment fallback, and a docs-ci smoke test to catch lingering broken references.
Aria: can you share example of the mapping YAML?
Ezra: sure, draft:
```yaml
- old: "optimize/quant_profiles/fast"
  new: "optkit/quant-profiles/fast.md"
- old: "optimize/examples/batching/producer_consumer.md"
  new: "optkit/examples/batching/producer-consumer.md"
- old: "optimize/kv_prefetch_example.py"
  new: "examples/kv-prefetch-python-0.4.py"
```
Nia: nice. for anchors, some teams link to #fp16 etc. what's the plan to preserve fragments?
Cal: add anchors.json that maps legacy fragment tokens to new ones and a tiny client-side script on redirect pages that reads the legacy fragment and scrolls to the mapped id. low risk and reversible.
Aria: about snippet fixes: do we patch the source snippet files or rely on the preprocessor?
Ezra: both. preprocessor gives immediate safety for staging and previews; we should also open small PRs to update canonical imports in snippet source files and add a one-line `MIGRATION: canonical -> /optkit/...` comment. avoid leaving code comments visible in rendered snippets (bundler tweak will strip them).
Nia: owners? i'll take the snippet PRs for python. Cal can take js/ts?
Cal: yep i'll handle js/ts. i'll also add a small integration test that imports the snippet module so we catch ModuleNotFound in CI.
Ezra: perfect. i'll own the redirect generator + anchors fallback (small Sphinx transform). docs-ci will need a new job that runs `sphinx-build -nW` on changed docs and snippets subset; who can own that?
Aria: i can add the docs-ci job. will make it opt-in behind a flag for first rollout.
Nia: sounds good. also recommend adding a telemetry ping on redirect pages so we can measure incoming traffic to legacy URLs during the 14-day window. helps decide deletion timing.
Cal: ok. small nit: some downstream repos import example files by exact filename (snake_case -> kebab-case rename). mapping YAML should include alternative legacy filenames to be safe.
Ezra: good call. i'll include both variants in the map. also we'll post a public deprecation notice in #integrations and tag known partners.
Aria: estimate for PRs?
Nia: snippet PRs by EOD, Cal's JS PR tomorrow morning with tests, Ezra's redirect + anchors PR today, Aria's docs-ci PR tomorrow.
Ezra: plan detail and owners:
- Ezra: add docs/_data/legacy_optimize_map.yml + Sphinx redirect transform + anchors.json (PR today)
- Nia: update python snippets imports + add migration comment (PR today)
- Cal: update js/ts snippets, add import smoke test (PR tom AM)
- Aria: add docs-ci snippet smoke job and opt-in flag (PR tom)
- All: run full staging linkcheck after merges and track remaining errors in this thread
docs-bot: Staging preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/4543 (linkcheck: 11 errors) :warning:

Cal: i'll pick up 6 of the 11 link errors (js snippets and a couple cookbook refs).
Nia: i'll take 4 (python snippets).
Ezra: i'll own the remaining 1 (quant anchor mapping).
Aria: i'll monitor docs-ci and watch for flakes; will add rollback steps in the job in case template change causes issues.
Ezra: final note: prefer two-step deletion (redirects first, then delete). we'll log deletion date in the PR and create a CHORE ticket to clean up after 14 days.
Nia: ack. i'll add a short migration blurb in the optkit README so external devs know what changed and how to update imports.
Cal: one more: update internal quickstart snippets that link to the Console to point at canonical optkit pages, not localized or legacy URLs. small follow-up PR.
Ezra: thanks all. i'll post the mapping file and a preview once the redirect PR builds. if anything blocks, drop a message here and we'll do a quick sync. :thumbsup:
